units.source_text: 忽然风起云涌，天昏地黑。

en.t: Suddenly the wind rose, clouds surged up, and heaven and earth grew dark.

units.source_text: 祓禊尚未完成，人人惊慌骚扰。

en.t: The purification rite was not yet finished, and everyone panicked and fell into confusion.

units.source_text: 大雨突如其来，声势异常猛烈。

en.t: A heavy rain came without warning, with an unusually fierce force.

units.source_text: 大家想逃回去，却来不及取斗笠。

en.t: Everyone wanted to flee back, but there was no time even to fetch their rain hats.

units.source_text: 不久以前，风平浪静，此时忽起暴风，飞沙走石，浪涛汹涌。

en.t: Only a short while before, the wind and waves had been calm; now a gale suddenly rose, sand and stones flew, and the billows surged violently.

units.source_text: 诸人狂奔返邸，几乎足不履地。

en.t: They all ran wildly back to the residence, scarcely feeling their feet touch the ground.

units.source_text: 海面好像盖了一床棉被，膨胀起来。

en.t: The surface of the sea seemed to swell as though covered with a thick cotton quilt.

units.source_text: 电光闪闪，雷声隆隆，仿佛雷电即将打在头上。

en.t: Lightning flashed and thunder rolled, as if the storm were about to strike directly overhead.

units.source_text: 众人好容易逃进了旅邸，惊诧地说：“这样的暴风雨，从来不曾见过。

en.t: At last everyone managed to escape into the lodging house, where they said in astonishment, "We have never seen a storm like this before.

units.source_text: 以前也曾起风，但总先有预兆。

en.t: Winds have risen before, but there was always some warning first.

units.source_text: 这样突如其来，实在可惊可怪！”

en.t: For it to come so suddenly is truly alarming and strange!"
The thunder still kept crashing without pause.

units.source_text: 雨点沉重落地，几乎穿通堦石。

en.t: The heavy raindrops struck the ground as if they might pierce through the stone steps.

units.source_text: 众人心慌意乱，叹道：“照这光景，世界要毁灭了！”

en.t: Everyone was distraught and cried out, "At this rate, the world is going to be destroyed!"

units.source_text: 独有源氏公子从容不迫地坐着诵经。

en.t: Only Prince Genji sat calmly and recited sutras.
